NAIA Approves Fifth Year of Eligibility

The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) membership has approved a landmark eligibility change, expanding the current four-year limit to five years of competition beginning in fall 2027. The new model provides student-athletes with greater flexibility to balance their academic and athletic pursuits, creating additional opportunities to compete while continuing their educational journey.
